title: Divide Intervals Into Minimum Number of Groups
source: Sorting as a tool (Week 7): a sweep over sorted times

tests.name: Touching ends overlap
tests.hint: The ends are inclusive: [1, 5] and [5, 8] share 5.

tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(2406)
cases = []
for _ in range(40):
    iv = []
    for _ in range(random.randint(1, 8)):
        a = random.randint(1, 15)
        iv.append([a, a + random.randint(0, 4)])
    cases.append(iv)

tests.name: 100 000 intervals
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(24060)
intervals = []
for _ in range(100000):
    a = random.randint(1, 10**6 - 1000)
    intervals.append([a, a + random.randint(0, 999)])
